title: Ada and the Extraction
author: Noor Kavanagh
blurb: Emrys Fairweather, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
